channel.title: Inside Retail Australia - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Inside Retail Australia (insideretail.com.au)

item.title: Record Black Friday and clothing integration drives Myer’s earnings surge
item.description: Department store and apparel retailer Myer is showing no signs of slowing down, reporting bumper first-half earnings in the wake of industry “volatility”.

item.title: ‘Limited scale and profitability’: KMD Brands rejects Rip Curl demerger proposal
item.description: Rip Curl owner KMD Brands has rejected a demerger offer from Stokehouse, a US-based surf company that it describes as having “limited scale and profitability”.

item.title: Inside Lanvin Group’s management shake-up and business reset
item.description: Four years after its 2022 public listing via SPAC, the group finds itself in a period of contraction. Leadership turnover, declining revenues, and a series of asset disposals point to a business retrenching to survive.

item.title: How AI is impacting five demand forecasting roles
item.description: By automating repetitive tasks and surfacing strategic insights, AI frees up retail teams to focus on decision-making rather than data wrangling.

item.title: 'Broad retail' in difficult circumstances: Myer's plan for the future
item.description: Olivia Wirth, the executive chair of Myer, spoke to Inside Retail following the department store’s most recent earnings update.

item.title: Myer boss pushes change with digital success
item.description: The pursuit of a strong digital platform and a diversified portfolio is going to continue for Myer, the group’s executive chair told Inside Retail.

item.title: Pop Mart opens first ANZ airport store at Sydney Airport
item.description: Pop Mart has launched its first airport retail store in ANZ, opening at Sydney Airport as part of its continued international expansion.

item.title: Articore lauds turnaround strategy, eyes growth
item.description: Online marketplace company Articore, the owner of Redbubble and TeePublic, has announced an executive appointment, an acquisition, and the end of a review as it continues with its turnaround strategy.

item.title: How is Nuuds scaling beyond its DTC roots?
item.description: "It’s important for us to stay true to our brand, always considering what will truly resonate with our customers," said Daryl-Ann Denner.

item.title: Retail’s second life: The Iconic’s bet on what happens after checkout
item.description: At The Iconic, sustainability is now something being worked into the everyday mechanics of retail. That shift is reflected in the role held by Gayle Burchell, chief commercial and sustainability officer, where responsibility for revenue sits alongside oversight of returns, waste and what happens to product once it leaves the warehouse.
